blocks.text: A TSH test is a blood test that measures thyroid-stimulating hormone. A TSH level that is too high or too low may be a sign of a thyroid problem.
The pituitary gland makes TSH, which tells the thyroid how much thyroid hormone it needs to make.
Measuring TSH can show whether the thyroid is making the right level of hormones.

title: TSH (Thyroid-stimulating hormone) Test
